_readme: Canonical machine-readable manifest for the Playing God target library. MANIFEST.md is generated from this file by tools/make-targets.mjs — edit HERE. House format for new targets: 22050 Hz, mono, 16-bit PCM WAV, peak-normalized to -1.0 dBFS after resampling, <=10 s. The two canonical targets are bit-identical copies of their historical files and are exempt from house format (their SSE numbers predate this library; converting them would silently change every existing result).

tiers.A: Core set for expensive runs (full ARTISAN builds, 24-48h GA runs). Four maximally complementary corners; keep clips short (<=4 s new, canonical exempt) because GA generation pace scales with target length (measured: chimes 9.5 s ran ~5x slower than speech 1.8 s).
tiers.B: Full bench: ARTISAN generality gates (BRIEF-3 §6.2) and the perceptual metric's ears-validation material (item 5). <=10 s per MUSHRA excerpt guidance.
tiers.M: Micro targets (<=1.5 s): single events. Inverts the slot-starvation axis — all 64 waves available for ONE event — and isolates attack/transient fidelity; render cost is tiny so iteration is near-free (the opposite pole of voice-sung-complex on target length). Owner's question 2026-09-05: what accuracy is reachable on a short, specific target?

Musopen-lineage orchestra item: PD Mark with thin performer attribution
